## Need

Describe what you are trying to do and where Cupid or its documentation falls
short. For a documentation request, link the page and identify the unclear step.

## Proposed behavior

Explain the result you would like. Include an example command or user interaction
when it helps.

## Evidence and validation

For hardware support, identify the board or peripheral, the relevant hardware
documentation, and any public diagnostic or reproducer. Explain how the change
could be checked. Mention related issues or pull requests.
